title: A New Digital Base: The Fresh Face of BlackAnt Games
badge: The wait is over! We have a new web page!
description: Welcome to the all-new blackantgames.com! We have completely rebuilt our website from the ground up to give you a clean, sleek look at our studio's future. This will be your primary hub for development logs, fresh announcements, and upcoming project reveals. You might notice our legacy titles, VR Galaxy Wars and VR Tank Wars, have been removed from the site—and the app stores. They served us incredibly well, but it's time to step into a brand-new era. Stay tuned, because a fresh game development cycle is officially underway!

title: Galaxy Wars: Attack on Earth — Out Now on Android!
description: The wait is officially over! The team at BlackAnt Games is thrilled to announce that Galaxy Wars: Attack on Earth has officially launched on Android. Prepare to dive headfirst into a relentless battle for humanity’s survival in a groundbreaking Augmented Reality experience. Forget clumsy virtual joysticks—in this game, YOU LITERALLY AIM WITH YOUR PHONE! Turn your device into a weapon and track incoming alien invaders just like a real-world shooting gallery. Download it today and test your reflexes!
